reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and we're stretched already on shift pay. I'd maybe try one $12 drop-in someday, but I wouldn't commit to a membership.
objection: Why pay $59 a month for something I can get for free at the library, the parks and church group? And with shift work I couldn't promise to use it enough to make it worth it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap first visit, plus a low-cost pay-per-visit option of about $5 to $6 with no monthly commitment.
